# Tiferes Final Plan — Speech Metadata to Verified AIFF

The Awtsmoos joins authored meaning and audible form; Awtsmoos.com lets the adapter carry the covenant, the generator prepare the vessel, and the browser prove the sound before ffmpeg gathers time.

## Source files to create
- `apps/animator/src/sharedMovie/AnimatorDialogueProjection.js` — focused canonical speech entity → Animator dialogue entry conversion preserving all speech metadata.
- `apps/animator/tools/browser-export/voices/AcceptanceVoiceSpecification.js` — exact two-line acceptance voice manifest with filenames, speakers, texts, installed macOS voices, and speaking rates.
- `apps/animator/tools/browser-export/voices/GenerateAcceptanceVoices.mjs` — validates manifest/voice availability and invokes `/usr/bin/say` through argv-safe child-process APIs.

## Existing source to rewrite
- `apps/animator/src/sharedMovie/AnimatorMoviePlanParts.js` — import/delegate dialogue projection, preserving every other public helper unchanged and reducing responsibility.

## Source-first verification before tests
- Syntax-check all new/rewritten JS.
- Enforce <=120 lines.
- Confirm tabs and mandatory prologue/poetry.

## Test files after source
- Adapter regression proving Miriam and Teacher preserve `speakerName` and speech metadata.
- Voice-spec/generator planning regression proving exact filenames/order/text and no arbitrary path surface.

## Generated evidence after tests
- Run generator to create `01-miriam.aiff` and `02-teacher.aiff`.
- Inspect sizes and AIFF headers.
- Browser-decode both through `AnimatorBrowserAiffDecoder` and record duration/sample rate/channels.
- Compare durations with dialogue windows.

## Runtime continuation
- Cold-launch 30-second ffmpeg proof.
- Require 360 uploaded frames, browser soundtrack, ffmpeg H.264/AAC result, and ffprobe success.
- Then cold-launch full 180-second / 2,160-frame proof and continue the existing completion graph.

## NEXT_ACTION
Read dialogue call sites/tests and current intent speech metadata, then perform the guarded source rewrite/new-file pass.
